text: 创业板指、科创50指数均跌超1%，沪指跌0.32%，创业板指跌0.66%，贵金属、煤炭、军工、航运等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近3200只。
text_en: The ChiNext Index and the STAR 50 Index both fell more than 1%, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.32%, and the ChiNext Index fell 0.66%, with precious metals, coal, defense, and shipping among the leading decliners, and nearly 3,200 stocks falling across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets.
